description: Keep derived artefacts honest: after editing a hardware design or its firmware, check that everything still describes the same board.

hooks.command: sh -c 'case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" in *.tsx|*config.py|*.kicad_sch|*mapping.ts) [ -f Makefile ] && grep -q "^check:" Makefile && make check 2>&1 | tail -20 ;; esac; exit 0'
